title: Preserve nonretryable Engram errors when the admission circuit is open
outcome: Confirmed Medium defect from Final16 Codex review session-7260, independently source-checked by supervisor. src/engram_host_adapter.rs engram_failure_card_code replaces the actual error code with control_circuit_open while the record circuit remains open; retained replay clears only the target copy. After three transport/deadline failures, a protocol/store/unknown remote error is consequently classified Retry by engram_admission_disposition instead of Reconcile, leaving Resume available. Preserve actual error kind/code for admission disposition and keep circuit-health diagnostics separate. Existing Final17 assignment to Termal::Coder/session-7223 covers implementation; this issue does not authorize another worker or expand scope.
acceptance: Regression drives exact prepared replay after the circuit opens, followed by store_corrupt, protocol and unknown remote error without disabled_reason. Prompt/key survive, interrupted and paused recovery is visible, provider delivery remains withheld, and no new bind/key is introduced. Genuine transient retries still work; cancellation owner fences remain intact.
